# Small order

A scenario of [Sales order lifecycle](../sales-order-lifecycle.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Name | `SmallOrder` |
| Starts at | `2000-01-01T00:00:00Z` |
| Start context | `creditLimit` = `1000`, `total` = `100` |
| Steps | 4 |
| Outcome | final |

## Walk-through

One row per step: who acts, the input, whether the process accepts it, and the active states after it.

| Step | Actor | Input | Result | States after | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 |  | event `submit` | accepted | `Fulfilment.Processing.Payment.AwaitingPayment`, `Fulfilment.Processing.Shipping.Picking` | Within the credit limit: straight to fulfilment. |
| 2 |  | event `pick` | accepted | `Fulfilment.Processing.Payment.AwaitingPayment`, `Fulfilment.Processing.Shipping.Packing` |  |
| 3 |  | event `ship` | accepted | `Fulfilment.Processing.Payment.AwaitingPayment`, `Fulfilment.Processing.Shipping.Shipped` |  |
| 4 |  | event `paymentReceived` | accepted | `Completed` | Both regions are final, so the order completes. |

## Outcome

After the last step the process has reached a final state.
